test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

N, P, R. T, V, X, ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e076124d43980ec05581c7608b1fea7d026b6fe0e2216e1092544ed52a07f589.png] 

**Given:**

N, P, R. T, V, X,?

**Logic:** (2) is added in the positional value of the alphabet in each step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/109c9172c53ebc95ccad68eb709979f7693583c2a28bc9efe188004c9e1bc1a3.png] 

Here, the question mark(?) is replaced by** 'Z'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
